text:
nathan: Heads-up: running a short "airgapped recovery" run tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Goal: validate RBAC rollback + audit log continuity when primary KMS is unreachable. Need one sec lead, one infra, and oncall.
lina.sec: I'll join. Two asks: 1) make sure audit events include the KMS key ID in the log context, 2) capture system authz failures (audit-annotate).
devops-amy: For the test cluster we'll swap the keystore config to `vault://local-cluster` and disable cloud-kms routes. I can script it.
ops-runner: Plan suggestion: (A) flip KMS to vault, (B) rotate a key and revoke leases, (C) apply RBAC rollback that removes cluster-admin from test-sa and grants minimal decrypt role, (D) run decrypt canaries.
lina.sec: Add these log checks: - ensure `/var/log/audit/keystore.log` has JSON entries with `key_id` and `result` fields - Fluent-bit forwarder must use TLS client cert to collector.
nathan: Netpols: we'll enforce egress deny by default and add an explicit allow to vault namespace on port 8200 and to internal-siem on 5044. Example snippet shared in thread.
devops-amy: snippet:
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: egress-allow-vault-siem
  namespace: test-app
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: vault
    ports:
    - port: 8200
    - port: 5044
```
lina.sec: Also pre-create a small audit-forward test: post a synthetic decrypt event and verify SIEM receives it within 30s.
ops-runner: I'll build a canary script that attempts decrypt every 5s and POSTs results to #eng-security-tests. If failures spike > 5 in 1m we'll hit the abort path.
oncall-bot: Created incident ticket: airgap-kms-rbac-recovery-1767777777, assignees: devops-amy, lina.sec, ops-runner. Link: https://internal/itk/airgap-kms-recovery-1767777777
devops-amy: Two known risks: a) keystore agent image needs the CVE patch for 2025-0420 applied (we'll run patched image), b) RBAC rollback must be applied idempotently to avoid lockouts. I'll add a dry-run flag to the rollback script.
lina.sec: We'll also run quick exploitability checks for the CVE and flag any environment where it's possible to escalate to `keystore-agent` exec.
nathan: Timeline: 07:30 UTC prep, 08:00 start, 08:20 rollback window/verify, 08:40 cleanup. Keep communication to this thread and #eng-security-tests for canary output. :white_check_mark:
